object.name: Eta Sgr
object.notes: Western constellation line-figure star (HIP 89642; Stellarium Sgr). SIMBAD identity * eta Sgr; SIMBAD compiled Johnson V=3.11; Bailer-Jones EDR3 geometric posterior median distance; absolute V uses no extinction correction. Reviewed physical values describe Eta Sgr. Exact * eta Sgr / HD 167618, HIP 89642. Source values describe this primary/individual; no companion, subsystem sum, or system-metallicity inference. Reviewed 151-target enrichment (2026-10-21). 2019A&A...624A..35K. Existing non-null values retain their independent sources. Calibrated granulation gravity and a literature radius; not a dynamical mass. Includes the source radius/distance assumptions. Published literature angular-diameter radius at its source parallax; not rescaled to the independent map distance. Published luminosity and radius are independent source estimates; their disagreement with a Stefan-Boltzmann combination is not silently erased. Shared exact-identity physical supplements (mass_solar: 2019A&A...624A..35K; radius_solar: 2019A&A...624A..35K; luminosity_solar: 2019A&A...624A..35K; temperature_k: 2020A&A...633A..34C; metallicity_dex: 2020A&A...633A..34C).
